interpretation: All intervals are relative to the start of one 500 ms observation. Native counts resolve 10 ms bins, not exact spike times or within-bin causal order. Voltages are sampled at bin ends and can miss threshold crossings and resets. Output-neuron count differences are intermediate activity, not new trading decisions; the fixed decoder emits one action after 500 ms. Later observations carry activity from earlier ones. This post-hoc analysis adds no model runs, trading returns or policy selection.
